findings.description: Probe c1 confirmed that install writes the provenance record across all three install shapes.
Probe c2 confirmed that clean-but-stale files upgrade in place with correct reporting.
Probe c3 confirmed that a mixed run refuses only real edits and upgrades clean files.
Probe c4 confirmed that a pre-provenance kit adopts what matches and preserves edited files.
Probe c6 confirmed that the provenance record is trackable in git and not ignored.
Test suite passed: 371 tests in test_hooks.py, 50 tests in test_build_plugin.py, and build-plugin.py --check validation succeeded.
findings.evidence: 371 passed in test_hooks.py, 50 passed in test_build_plugin.py, validation passed
